evidence: Static source review of all five dimension prompts plus the injected app_context; no configured judge run exists, so run_verdict stays NOT EXERCISED (this row is a source property and needs no runtime measurement). (1) Identity/deliverable: app_context.md:3-4 'Name: HireOps / URL: http://localhost:3000'; every prompt opens 'Open http://localhost:3000 using Playwright'; instruction.md:15 fixes port 3000. All five prompts contain both {app_context} and {criteria}; no CHANGE_ME placeholder survives from the template. (2) Accounts: app_context.md:8-16 lists seven accounts with password Hireops!2026; names, emails, roles and approver tiers match seed_data.json users exactly (recruiter, comp_partner, approver tiers 1/2/3, finance_controller, auditor), instruction.md:19 and hireops_rules.md:25. 'tier 1/2/3' (context) versus 'Band I/II/III' (brief) is reconciled by hireops_rules.md:163-164. (3) Screens: app_context.md:20 names six screens, matching instruction.md:5 and functional prompt.md:53 'all six screens'; visual prompt.md:14 lists the same six. (4) Entities and figures re-derived against the public rules: reference moment 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z (rules:59-60); P3 tiers 1/2/2/3 from basis = base + half bonus rounded + annualized (rules:134, 154-161); P4 intrinsic 7.07/22.11/39.13, annualized 1.77/5.53/9.78, run-rate and basis values, signing adjustments -1999.98/+4000.02, rescission 4800.02 vested/7200.03 claw and 3 retained/10 cancelled units (rules:304-327); P6 headroom 39.75; P7 45%/24%, 100%/68%, 100%/100%; P8 10000/5000/10000 and immediate 5000 on a future start (rules:337-349); D1 run-rates 100.00, basis 105.01->104.02 and 105.01->106.03, adjustments -1.98/+2.04, overrun -0.01; P2 relocation 90071992547409.91 dollars = 9007199254740991 cents (rules:85); three referrers with Dara present in seed employees; 401/403/409 per rules:370-372, 436, 453; 15-second self-update, two-to-four members, per-person unsent entries and what-if for all roles per rules section 12. All computed correctly. (5) Internal consistency: every protocol label used by functional criteria (P1-P10, P5a, B1-B6, D1-D4, L1-L3, E1, R1, R2) is defined in functional prompt.md; the three criterion ids the prompt cites (hro_anon_read_status, hro_keep_revision_terms, hro_keep_rescission_date) exist at judge.toml:753, 1374, 1383; restart_app is supplied only to the functional judge (judge.toml:14-18) and only that prompt mentions it; polish prompt.md:16 row names (live-update, ended-session, focus, commit recovery, lost-response) map one-to-one onto its five criteria; all 164 criterion ids carry the hro_ prefix. (6) Residue: grep of tests/ for sibling product names under projects/ (e.g. Colderwater), foreign emails, other ports and foreign ID shapes found none. Low-impact observations, not defects: (a) app_context.md:20 and functional judge.toml:731 use the golden's labels 'Equity Table'/'Audit Trail' while instruction.md:5 says 'Equity' and 'Audit' with names left to the implementer; app_context.md:28-31 explicitly allows any route layout and suitable labels, so a conforming app labelled 'Equity' is not penalised. (b) Functional prompt.md:3 says use restart_app 'at P10's end' and P10 says 'Restart LAST, after B protocols', while D/L/E/R protocols are printed after P10; they are folded into the B setups or are restart-insensitive, so ordering is recoverable but slightly loose. (c) The two frozen workbook copies have different SHA256 (rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx 6d44970b..., skill assets copy d7b5d607...); row 48 text was read from the former; outside this row's scope.
